interactions.name: upper_left_panel_cycle
interactions.action: In the single host dynamics attempt, begin closed, open this joint to its nonzero 90 degree endpoint while others hold closed, hold briefly and return; also exercise simultaneous openings in one bounded phase. Check actual visible mesh displacement and endpoint error.
interactions.expected: Panel rotates outward about its outer vertical edge and returns; upper-right strip follows its panel. Before simulation, cheap geometric hierarchy check at 0, 45 and 90 degrees verifies hinge-side attachment continuity and that no stationary strip is left on moving surface. Record measured results, including failures; this plan is not a success receipt.

review_requirements: Verify every source face is assigned exactly once, unchanged in rest-world geometry/UV/PBR under the declared similarity transform. Confirm all four moving selections have visible front surfaces, the +X control strip and mark belong to upper_right_panel, grip fragments follow their appropriate panel, and the enclosure retains the opposite facade. Save a rest comparison and ownership receipt; do not count a fixed duplicate or empty root as moving coverage.

Using cheap geometric pose checks, inspect each panel at its finite minimum, midpoint and maximum (signed 0/45/90 degrees), including a combined-open pose. Record visible hinge-side continuity and measured gap to enclosure at representative upper/lower attachment points, with images showing both moving and fixed surfaces. Flag visibly detached panels, stationary strips on moving fronts, or broad tearing. State exposed interior gaps separately. This is a construction check, not another dynamics run; preserve strict native surfaces and report any failed attachment.

Within the one host mj_step attempt, exercise each of the four named panel hinges independently and a bounded combined phase, returning toward closed. Record finite body/joint states, actual achieved ranges, endpoint errors against the frozen 10-degree tolerance, and corresponding native-surface displacement/binding. Each panel must visibly move with its own joint; compare displacement to the policy 0.01 object-diagonal criterion. Check rest and sampled contacts using the frozen helper, without a fine sweep or unsupported locality claims. Keep the initial 90-degree ranges unless measured large collisions justify permitted limited-joint backoff and consistent receipts.

Verify the delivered preview controls operate all four panel surfaces with correct root-offset mapping and the display follows the upper-right panel. Report each action separately as planned, simulated success/failure, or parameter-preview-only, retaining actual failures and missing electronic behavior. Include native rear duplication and exposed-interior limitations; do not label preview motion or tolerated contact as strict physical acceptance.

approximation_gaps.reason: Strict native preservation retains duplicated opposite-face appearance, uncertain panel thickness, and incomplete newly exposed interior/back surfaces. No added cavity or hinge geometry is required for this minimal pivot-at-boundary construction; endpoint continuity must be checked downstream.

Simple wall and panel proxies approximate irregular native geometry; small seam contacts use frozen tolerance helper. A tolerated contact is not strict collision-free validation. Hidden compartment contents and fine handle contact are unmodeled.
